LanguageData.DMS_Mech_HermitCrab.label: Hermit Crab
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_HermitCrab.description: A huge, expensive and cumbersome mobile industrial mother machine, mostly designed and built by worlds intent on space colonization. Its huge, expensive magnetically stabilized cylindrical shell integrates a bewildering number of multi-axis CNC tools and micro manipulators. The same magnetic field doubles as a short-range ballistic interception barrier - a by-product its manufacturers are happy to advertise. It is precise enough to perform surgery, provided the patient can overcome their fear of having a machine weighing several tons as their surgeon. The shell also houses an engineering drone bay, letting it carry and deploy uca and erima work drones in the field.
